subject: Add orchestrator engine + rich notifications panel; drop Telegram
body:
Add orchestrator engine + rich notifications panel; drop Telegram

Orchestrator:
- OrchestratorEngine: Claude-powered loop reads session log, decides next command,
  maintains a timestamped journal; GetStatusSummaryAsync() powers "What are you doing?"
- OrchestratorRegistry: ConcurrentDictionary of active engines, Start/Stop/Get/GetAll
- OrchestrateSessionDialog: task context form launched from session tab context menu
- OrchestratorStatusForm: shows Claude summary + full journal, Stop/Refresh buttons
- HealthMonitor: 5-minute timer alerts via NickHQ when orchestrated sessions go quiet
- ConnectionTab: context menu (Orchestrate/What are you doing?/Stop), animated ⚙ toolbar
  indicator cycling ⚙/◌ with colour by status

Notifications:
- NotificationsWindow: dockable panel polling NickHQ /alerts every 15s with rich
  ListView (level icon, title, session, time), body preview, Go to Session /
  What's happening? / Stop / Dismiss action buttons; auto-surfaces on error/warning
- alerts.py: removed Telegram forwarding — NickHQ is now the notification hub

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
